attr1:
index=notable 
| eval eventtime=coalesce(eventtime,_time)
| eval severity="Low"| eval status="New"| eval disposition="Undetermined" |eval alert_id=md5(_raw+tostring(eventtime)) 
| eval TITLE= coalesce(detection_name,source) 
| eventstats count as duplicate_alert by _raw
| eval duplicate_alert = duplicate_alert -1
| table * | fields - orig_* date_* punct linecount _* count
| dedup alert_id
| lookup secalerts_comments alert_id as alert_id OUTPUT customkey
| mvexpand customkey
| lookup secalerts_comments customkey as customkey OUTPUT assigned_to,comment,created,disposition,status,user
| eval status=if(isnull(status),"New",status)| eval disposition=if(isnull(disposition),"Undetermined",disposition) , created=if(isnull(created),eventtime,created)
| sort 0 + alert_id created
| eventstats last(status) as last_status last(assigned_to) as last_assigned_to last(disposition) as last_disposition by alert_id
| eval status=case(isnotnull(last_status),last_status) | eval disposition=case(isnotnull(last_disposition),last_disposition) | eval assigned_to=case(isnotnull(last_assigned_to),last_assigned_to)
| eval created = strftime(created,"%d-%m-%Y %H:%M") , eventtime=strftime(eventtime,"%d-%m-%Y %H:%M")
|fields - timeendpos timestamp timestartpos _mkv_child info_search_time
